summary: Cupola cabin (1923) and slab-frame cabin (1939) on a Bonner County summit, both destroyed in a 1967 forest fire; no remnants found.

facts.status_note: Both cabins destroyed in a 1967 forest fire; one site visitor found no remnants on the summit

events.note: Fire warden's report: two horses and saddles furnished to pack to the lookout
Both cabins destroyed in a forest fire; the sources do not name the fire

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says Priest Lake TPA and the Rex's page says Pend Oreille TPA. The story does not name either.
The Rex's page gives the legal description as 58N-2E-17, while the 1927 fire warden report it quotes says township 53 north. Not resolved; the story gives no township.
5763 ft on firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; 5,745 ft on the WillhiteWeb.com site page. The story gives no figure.

notes_for_editor: Built dates (1923, 1939) and the 1967 destruction agree across all four sources. No source names the 1967 fire. The Sundance fire (started August 23, 1967, near Sundance Mountain, Priest Lake area; sandpoint.com history page) is a different documented 1967 blaze, and no source ties it to this lookout, so it is not mentioned. The brief record's county (Bonner), status (gone) and 1967 destroyed event are correct. No photos added: firelookout.com credits a photo to the Fire Lookout Museum but gives no image URL. The site is reachable only by roads that the WillhiteWeb.com author says are covered with trees; no source says whether it is open to visitors, so no access level is recorded.
